```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))




```
#Problem 1

load the data

```{r}
data("ny_noaa")
```

## data cleaning

```{r}
ny_noaa_df = ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year  = factor(year(date)),   
    month = month(date),  
    day   = mday(date),
    prcp = prcp / 10,       
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10, 
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10
  ) 

dim(ny_noaa_df)
summary(ny_noaa_df)

ny_noaa_df |>
  count(snow) |>
  head(10)
```

##January vs July

```{r}
mean_tmax = ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(month == 1 | month == 7) |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = c(1,7), labels = c("January", "July"))
  ) |>
  group_by(id, year, month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  view()
```

```{r}
mean_tmax |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_tmax, colour = month)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = month), se = FALSE) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ month) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = seq(1980, 2010, by = 5)
  ) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE) + 
  labs(
    title = "Average Max Temperature Trend in January and July ", 
    x = "Year", 
    y = "Max Temp",
    caption = "Average Max Temperature in January and in July in Each Station Across Years",
    color = "Month"
  ) 
```

```{r}
plot_1 = ny_noaa_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_hex() +
  theme(legend.position = "right") + 
  labs(
    title = "Max Temperature Versus Min temperature", 
    x = "Minimum temperature", 
    y = "Maximum temperature"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.87, 0.15), 
    legend.background = element_rect(fill="white", alpha=0.8) # 加半透明白底，避免盖住点
  )
  


plot_2 = ny_noaa_df |>
  filter(snow > 0, snow < 100) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = snow, y = year)) +
  geom_density_ridges() +
  scale_y_discrete(
    breaks = seq(1980, 2010, by = 5)
  ) +
  labs(x ="Snowfall (mm)", y =  "Year", title = "Snowfall by year") 

plot_1 + plot_2

```
